name: The Missing Children
objective: Several young trainers have disappeared from Hollyhollow. Everyone assumes Team Krampus kidnapped them. Track them into the forest.
intro: You find the children — but they are not prisoners. They are training. Willingly.
dialogue: Krampus Keeper: "The children are here because they want to be."
Krampus Keeper (defeated): "We don't steal children. We teach them what your villages refuse to."
lore_discovery: Team Krampus has been teaching the children how to defend themselves against aggressive Pokémon. The organization becomes more ambiguous.
